rationale: The winning 600s run never reaches the step-based recurrence ramp, so the active training profile is effectively [tail_recur_min_gain, 1.0] while final exact eval uses full gains. The staged script improved when this first recurrent-tail gain was lower than the earlier linear profile; this run nudges that active gain from 0.35 to 0.32 while preserving the reverse-tail architecture, export budget, quant-aware endgame, and exact final evaluation path.
title: Lower First Reverse-Tail Recurrence Gain
